items.context: Add a small Multi-Model M2 authorization artifact that records humanApproval, dated snapshots, prompt/tool digests, runner ownership, duplicate policy, sequencing limits, and B-11be provider budget cap USD 0.00. For B-11be, the valid state is local metadata authorization with providerCallEnabled=false, budget cap USD 0.00, cell 03 as next formal step, and cell 06 blocked until a real cell-03-derived budget lock from a later provider-execution story.
